Apply Now!
South Carolina State University's College of Graduate and Professional Studies is
here to empower you with the talent and in-depth knowledge you'll need to advance
your career and take the lead in your chosen field. Home to five departments—including
the new Department of Speech Pathology and Audiology—the College of Graduate and Professional
Studies offers a wide range of challenging and rewarding programs that will give you
the edge you need to stand out amongst other job candidates.
Enhance Your Career With a Degree From South Carolina State University
The College of Graduate and Professional Studies offers 19 subject matter emphases
comprising 12 unique undergraduate and graduate degree programs. These programs include
an Ed.D. and an Ed.S. in Educational Administration, two M.A. programs, one M.A.T,
four M.Ed., and three M.S. programs. Regardless of which area fits your interests
and professional goals, you'll discover thorough and up-to-date curriculums built
around the latest innovations, techniques, and processes in each field.
It all starts with you: take your first step toward building the career you've dreamed
of by applying to SC State.
View & Downlad the Graduate Catalog
Apply Now!
Explore Our Programs
In all of our graduate and professional studies programs, you'll be instructed by
expert and caring faculty. More than just educators, many of these professors are
also accomplished in their fields and are eager to share with you all they've learned
from their years of experience.
As you pursue your bachelor's or master's degree, you'll have the opportunity to get
hands-on in a variety of experiential learning scenarios, including internships and
practicums. In doing so, you'll not only get to put your new knowledge and skills
to the test but also make important professional connections that can lead to employment
opportunities. Equally important, you'll be studying and working alongside a dedicated
cohort of fellow students who will inspire you to be your best and form a community
offering you support and encouragement.

University!

Department of Speech Pathology & Audiology
Are you interested in the science of communication and hearing? Do you want to build

Graduate Studies
SC State University offers several graduate and certificate programs that can advance

Military Science (ROTC)
Are you a passionate leader? A team player? A critical thinker looking to unlock your
potential? Welcome to Army ROTC at South Carolina State University! Our mission is
to educate and mentor future leaders, providing you with the critical thinking skills
and the moral character to effectively lead our nation’s armed forces.
